finding.statement: For any closed substack Y' of M_{6,6} with dim Y' < 8, the kernel-form term ker(T -> W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6} minus Y';Q)(21)) is zero, since H^{BM}_{16}(Y';Q)=0 whenever 16 > 2 dim Y'. Combined with monotonicity of kernel-form terms in the support, this yields a dimension floor for the whole campaign: a closed support can contribute a nonzero subspace to the ATT-0120 term T_Z only if it has dimension at least 8, hence only in the range 8 <= dim <= 17 given dim Y <= 17. In particular every constant or product clause-(E) model, whose classifying image in M_{6,6} is contained in the at-most-two-dimensional set of ordered reduced members of a single linear system on a single fixed curve, contributes exactly zero to T_Z. Such models are therefore inert in BOTH directions: they can neither disprove nor support the exact C66-TATE-SUPPORT theorem, whatever their standalone Hodge types, and their exclusion needs no pushforward on compactly supported cohomology.
